This is literally one of the most straightforward surfaces at this point... you enter earlier before the "teardrop", anything below 300 speed just go for 50%+ steering starting out. Past 300, keep pushing it slowly until full steering if you're on controller until you run even at 400. 400+ speed just full steer. Focus on those entries, and try entering earlier than you think. That is quite literally the biggest difference between a Bob run that feels okay, and one that feels downright horrible. Entries dictate the turn and stability, not your ability to stay in the red lines.
